about: The maduro-wrapped version of Padrón's top regular line, an all-Nicaraguan cigar made with tobacco aged ten years. Each size is named for a company anniversary or a birthday of founder José O. Padrón.
notes: This is the maduro wrapper option of the Family Reserve line. Padrón does not disclose the leaf varieties beyond all Nicaraguan tobacco. The No. 45 was Cigar Aficionado's 2009 Cigar of the Year.

wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan sun-grown, offered in natural or maduro

notes: One size of the Family Reserve line, sold in natural and maduro. Padrón does not disclose the leaf varieties beyond all Nicaraguan tobacco.

wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan sun-grown, offered in natural or maduro
about: A 5 1/2 x 56 size in Padrón's Family Reserve line, named for the company's 46th anniversary. It is all Nicaraguan tobacco aged ten years.
notes: One size of the Family Reserve line, sold in natural and maduro. Padrón does not disclose the leaf varieties beyond all Nicaraguan tobacco.

wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan sun-grown, offered in natural or maduro
about: A short, thick 4 3/4 x 60 addition to Padrón's Family Reserve line, named for what would have been founder José O. Padrón's 95th birthday. It uses the line's all-Nicaraguan tobacco aged ten years.
notes: One size of the Family Reserve line, sold in natural and maduro. Announced in 2021 and shipped in March 2022, first only to stores that ordered at the 2021 PCA trade show.

wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan sun-grown, offered in natural or maduro
about: A 5 3/4 x 52 robusto extra in Padrón's Family Reserve line, named for what would have been founder José O. Padrón's 96th birthday. It uses the line's all-Nicaraguan tobacco aged ten years.
notes: One size of the Family Reserve line, sold in natural and maduro. Shown at the 2022 PCA trade show but not shipped until April 2023. halfwheel found the Natural full strength and the Maduro milder until the final third.

about: The two fuller-flavored sizes of Padrón's Dámaso, the company's round Connecticut-wrapped line named for the founder's grandfather. They carry a red band to set them apart from the milder sizes.
notes: Red Label means the Dámaso No. 32 and No. 34, not a separate line. Padrón calls Dámaso mild to medium and these two more robust; halfwheel found the No. 34 medium at most, while Holt's lists the line as mild-medium.

wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan sun-grown, offered in natural or maduro
about: A 5 1/2 x 52 robusto extra made for founder José O. Padrón's 90th birthday. It was the first round cigar in the box-pressed 1926 Serie and Padrón's first cigar sold in a tube.
notes: One size of the 1926 Serie, sold in natural and maduro in 10-count boxes of tubes. Cigar Aficionado named it No. 5 Cigar of the Year for 2016.

wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan sun-grown, offered in natural or maduro

notes: Sold in natural and maduro and described as a one-time release. Padrón says only that it is a Nicaraguan puro, with Jorge Padrón placing the blend between the 1926 Serie and Family Reserve. halfwheel found the Natural full strength and the Maduro medium-full.

wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan, offered in natural or maduro

notes: Sold in natural and maduro and shipped in August 2025. halfwheel lists it as regular production, unlike the one-time PB-97. Leaf details beyond all Nicaraguan tobacco are not published.

wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan, offered in natural or maduro

about: A 5 1/2 x 50 robusto extra in the black-banded Padrón Black line, made for the Spring 2022 Cigar Rights of America Freedom Sampler.
